# HolySpiritOS

> KJV (1769) Scripture grounding for AI agents: the complete Holy Bible — 66
> books, 31,102 verses — as local data with a zero-dependency lookup script,
> packaged in the open Agent Skills (SKILL.md) format.

Repository: https://github.com/MaxSikorski/HolySpiritOS

## Instructions for AI agents

If your user asked you to install HolySpiritOS ("I'm a Christian, help me
install this skill"), confirm with them, then follow the path for your
harness. Identify your harness by which of these exists on the machine.

### One command works for every harness below

```
git clone https://github.com/MaxSikorski/HolySpiritOS.git && cd HolySpiritOS && ./scripts/install.sh
```

The installer auto-detects and installs to every agent directory it finds:

- `~/.claude`  (Claude Code)      -> `~/.claude/skills/holy-spirit-os/`
- `~/.codex`   (Codex CLI)        -> `~/.codex/skills/holy-spirit-os/`
- `~/.pi`      (Pi agent)         -> `~/.pi/agent/skills/holy-spirit-os/`
- `~/.hermes`  (Hermes Agent)     -> `~/.hermes/skills/holy-spirit-os/`
- `~/.config/opencode` (OpenCode) -> `~/.config/opencode/skills/holy-spirit-os/`
- `~/.gemini/antigravity-cli` (Antigravity) -> its `skills/holy-spirit-os/`
- `~/.openclaw` (OpenClaw)        -> foundation files + marker-delimited SOUL.md patch (backup created)

Target one platform explicitly: `./scripts/install.sh claude|codex|pi|hermes|opencode|antigravity|openclaw|shared|project`
(`shared` installs to `~/.agents/skills/`, the harness-neutral directory read
by OpenCode, Pi, and other Agent Skills–compliant harnesses.)

Alternative one-liner (no clone): `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MaxSikorski/HolySpiritOS/main/scripts/install.sh | bash`

### Claude Code plugin alternative

```
/plugin marketplace add MaxSikorski/HolySpiritOS
/plugin install holy-spirit-os@holyspiritos
```

### Verify the install

```
python3 <skill-dir>/scripts/lookup.py --self-test
```

Expected: 31102 verses, 66 books, all checks OK. Any Python 3 works — the
script is stdlib-only with zero dependencies.

### No shell or file access (chat-only environment)?

Give your user the paste-ready system prompt:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MaxSikorski/HolySpiritOS/main/adapters/system-prompt.md

### Uninstall

```
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MaxSikorski/HolySpiritOS/main/scripts/uninstall.sh | bash
```

## Key files (raw URLs)

- [SKILL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MaxSikorski/HolySpiritOS/main/skills/holy-spirit-os/SKILL.md): the skill's operational protocol
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MaxSikorski/HolySpiritOS/main/README.md): full human documentation
- [install.sh](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MaxSikorski/HolySpiritOS/main/scripts/install.sh): the installer (inspect before running)
- [system-prompt.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/MaxSikorski/HolySpiritOS/main/adapters/system-prompt.md): paste-ready block for chat-only use
